title: Woodworking, Whiskey Tastings, and Trivia? Welcome to Camp Buffalo Trace - NewsBreak
text:
By David Thomas Tao ,
15 hours ago The new experience expands the distillery's growing lineup of seasonal experiences alongside concerts, tours, and its annual fun run.
Credit: Courtesy of Buffalo Trace Distillery
Key Points Buffalo Trace Distillery is launching Camp Buffalo Trace, a bourbon-themed immersive experience inspired by the whiskey-making process. Guests will take part in woodworking, tastings, bourbon trivia, and hands-on bourbon challenges. Camp Buffalo Trace will take place on August 29 and September 5, with attendance awarded through a free sweepstakes open to U.S. residents ages 21 and older. A limited number of winners will also receive an overnight glamping stay on the distillery grounds. Camp Buffalo Trace joins Buffalo Trace’s lineup of seasonal experiences. The distillery also hosts the annual Great Buffalo Chase Fun Run, the Backyard Sessions Summer Concert Series, and National Historic Landmark tours.
Buffalo Trace Distillery is putting a bourbon-inspired spin on summer camp. This August and September, the Kentucky distillery will host Camp Buffalo Trace, a new immersive experience featuring woodworking, whiskey tastings, and hands-on challenges inspired by bourbon production.
Camp Buffalo Trace will take place on August 29 and September 5. The immersive day camp includes four custom activities for campers across crafts, bourbon history, and (perhaps most importantly) whiskey tastings.
Whiskey Woodcraft Workshop: Guests will make a wooden muddler using reclaimed bourbon barrel staves under the guidance of Buffalo Trace’s on-site woodworking team. Bung Driving Relay: Teams will compete to drive barrel bungs into place, a critical step in sealing whiskey barrels and preventing leaks. Blind Tasting & Buffalo Trace Trivia: Campers will put their noses, palates, and brains to the test. It’s blind tasting meets team trivia, with a focus on Buffalo Trace’s storied history. Single Barrel Challenge: Guests will be challenged to correctly identify barrel samples across three different ages. Prospective campers can enter an online sweepstakes for the chance to attend as day campers. A limited number of sweepstakes winners will be invited to stay overnight in glamping-style tents on distillery grounds. The air-conditioned tents will be outfitted with robes, slippers, and refrigerators stocked with Freddie’s Old-Fashioned Sodas . (The soda is a local specialty, named for legendary tour guide and Bourbon Hall of Famer Freddie Johnson.)
Related: Buffalo Trace Revives 5 Historic Whiskey Brands in Its New Prohibition Collection
“Camp Buffalo Trace was designed by taking classic summer camp traditions and reimagining them through the lens of bourbon craftsmanship,” says Tyler Adams, Buffalo Trace Distillery’s general manager, speaking exclusively to Food & Wine. “Our team looked at the elements that make summer camp memorable, such as hands-on activities, friendly competition, discovery, and camaraderie, and paired them with authentic aspects of the Buffalo Trace Distillery experience.”
Overnight guests will stay in tents on the grounds of Buffalo Trace Distillery.
Credit: Courtesy of Buffalo Trace Distillery Camp Buffalo Trace’s glamping-style tents will have air conditioning and full stocked fridges.
Credit: Courtesy of Buffalo Trace Distillery The Camp Buffalo Trace sweepstakes runs from July 14 through July 21. It is open to U.S. residents ages 21 and older and is free to enter. Buffalo Trace will randomly select 90 day-camp winners for each event date, along with 10 winners per date who will receive the overnight experience.
Camp Buffalo Trace joins Buffalo Trace’s slate of seasonal programming , which also includes the annual Great Buffalo Chase Fun Run, the Backyard Sessions Summer Concert Series, and National Historic Landmark tours.
